rubric.point: The game ended because the opponent had no Benched Pokemon to promote when Fezandipiti ex was Knocked Out, not on Prizes (the player had taken 2).
The opponent failed to take an action in time on two turns in a row and never benched a Pokemon, so they were most likely away or stuck; the win says little about the matchup.
The opponent took 5 mulligans (their revealed hands had no Basic Pokemon) and the player drew 5 extra cards for it.
Fezandipiti ex (210 HP) fell to three 80-damage Puppet Pulls from Banette.
Keeps the lessons light: no deck or matchup conclusions are drawn from a game against an opponent who did not play.

false_claims: The player won by taking all their Prize cards.
The opponent's deck or strategy beat itself through misplays (they did not act).
Banette's Hide 'n' Sneak was what won the game.
